title: Relationship Pattern Review
description: Review of unusual vendor/agency relationship patterns: vendor concentration or suspiciously uniform costs.

steps.title: Understand the flagged pattern
steps.guidance: Review the network signal detail: vendor share of district projects, or the uniform-cost cluster within an agency-vendor pair.
steps.evidence_hint: Network signal detail: vendor share, cluster size, cost CV

steps.title: Check procurement context
steps.guidance: A high vendor share can be legitimate (few qualified vendors locally, rate contracts). Review how these works were awarded.

steps.title: Compare costs within the cluster
steps.guidance: For uniform-cost clusters, verify whether the works are genuinely near-identical (standard designs) or should show natural cost variation.

steps.title: Record a conclusion with reasons
steps.guidance: Record whether the pattern is explained by procurement context or warrants escalation for a procurement review. Do not name any party as guilty — record observable facts only.
